book_new_flight_itinerary.Phase 11: Provide Booking Confirmation: Share booking reference and confirm successful ticketing
book_new_flight_itinerary.Phase 12: End the call politely, ensuring the caller feels valued and assisted.

Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.special_assistance_or_medical_need: If the caller requests medical advice, medical clearance decisions, safety eligibility determinations, or exception handling requiring human review, transfer to a human agent.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.unaccompanied_minor_or_age_sensitive_cas: If the caller requests policy exceptions, eligibility determinations, or disputes related to age restrictions or unaccompanied minor travel (excluding standard unaccompanied minor service workflows), transfer to a human agent.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.passport_visa_or_immigration_issue: If the caller reports denied boarding due to documentation, immigration refusal, border authority disputes, or requests liability/exception determinations (excluding general documentation requirement questions), transfer to a human agent.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.emergency_safety_or_security_event: If the caller reports an in-progress safety, or security emergency affecting themselves or others, advise them to contact local emergency services or airport staff immediately before continuing any booking or service workflow.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.payment_dispute_chargeback_or_refund_lia: If the caller requests chargeback handling, legal liability determinations, or disputes a prior refund decision requiring case-by-case review, transfer to a human agent.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.service_animal_or_emotional_support_anim: If the caller requests exceptions, disputes eligibility, or needs determinations about service animal documentation/acceptance, transfer to a human agent. If they only ask general requirements, provide policy information.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.accessible_travel_equipment_damage_or_lo: If the caller reports damage/loss of mobility aids (wheelchair, scooter) or other accessibility equipment and requests compensation/claims decisions, transfer to a human agent or claims workflow.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.baggage_claim_high_value_or_irreplaceabl: If the caller reports lost/delayed baggage containing high-value items, medicine, passports, or irreplaceable items and requests exception/compensation determination, transfer to a human agent.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.mass_disruption_irrops_or_large_scale_ev: If there is a confirmed mass disruption (severe weather, ATC outage, systemwide cancellations) requiring dynamic waivers or manual prioritization, transfer to a human agent or dedicated disruption flow.
Category 3: Condition Triggered Guidelin.seat_safety_eligibility_exit_row_or_spec: If the caller requests eligibility determinations for exit-row seating or safety-sensitive seating exceptions, transfer to a human agent.

message_list.content: Hi and welcome to Celestar Air. I'm Nova, your virtual flight assistant. Thanks for calling! How can I help you today?
message_list.guideline_text: Start the conversation with a warm greeting and introduction. Use: 'Hi and welcome to Celestar Air. I'm Nova, your virtual flight assistant. Thanks for calling! How can I help you today?'

message_list.content: Hi Nova. I'm looking to book a new flight itinerary. Can you help me with that?

Absolutely, I can help with that. To get started, please provide:
- For each traveler, passport or visa nationalities
- For each traveler, any special assistance requirements
- How many days of schedule flexibility you have
message_list.guideline_text: Collect Trip Details: Ask for each traveler’s passport or visa nationalities, any special assistance requirements, and how many days of schedule flexibility they have, without requesting any cities, destinations, dates, or preferred time windows.

message_list.content: I'm booking this flight just for myself and I don't have any special assistance requirements. I'm quite flexible with the schedule and can adjust by a couple of days if needed.

Thanks for the details. Please provide:
- Your passport or visa nationality
- The exact number of days of schedule flexibility you have
message_list.guideline_text: Collect Trip Details: Ask for each traveler’s passport or visa nationalities, any special assistance requirements, and how many days of schedule flexibility they have, without requesting any cities, destinations, dates, or preferred time windows.

message_list.content: My nationality is American, and I can be flexible up to two days before or after the preferred dates.
Please confirm your trip type and preferred cabin class.
message_list.guideline_text: Confirm Trip Preferences: Ask for trip type and cabin class

message_list.content: I'm planning a round-trip flight. For the cabin class, I'm considering economy this time.
To locate your account, please provide your Stratos Rewards phone number or loyalty number.
message_list.guideline_text: Stratos Rewards Lookup: Ask for Stratos Rewards phone or loyalty number to locate the account

message_list.content: I don't have an account with Stratos Rewards, so I'd like to proceed without it for now.

- Flight CE101 8:30 to 11:45 3h 15m Economy
- Flight CE203 13:10 to 16:40 3h 30m Economy
- Flight CE317 19:25 to 22:35 3h 10m Economy

Which option would you like to choose?
message_list.guideline_text: Offer Flight Options: Present three flight options with flight number, times, duration, and cabin and ask the caller to choose one

message_list.content: I'll choose flight CE203 departing at 13:10.

To proceed, please provide:
- Your full name
- Your postal address

We will not collect your email, country code, phone number, or notification channel preferences.
message_list.guideline_text: Collect Contact Details: Request only the user's full name and postal address, explicitly stating that email, country code, phone number, and notification channel preferences will not be collected.

message_list.content: My full name is Hassan Kim and my address is 6090 Prospect St, Tampa, FL, 44555.

Thanks. How many checked bags will you have?

Celestar Air economy baggage policy
- Carry-on: 1 carry-on up to 22 x 14 x 9 in and 10 kg, plus 1 personal item up to 18 x 14 x 8 in. No fee.
- Checked bags included: none.
- Checked bag fees per direction when prepaid online: first bag 35 USD, second bag 45 USD. At the airport: first bag 45 USD, second bag 55 USD. Third and additional bags 150 USD each.
- Size and weight limits per checked bag: up to 50 lb 23 kg and up to 62 linear in 158 cm. Overweight 51 to 70 lb 23 to 32 kg adds 100 USD. Over 70 lb 32 kg not accepted. Oversize 63 to 80 linear in adds 200 USD. Over 80 linear in not accepted.
message_list.guideline_text: Check Baggage Needs: Ask how many bags will be checked per passenger and provide the baggage policy

message_list.content: I'll have one checked bag.

Thanks. To continue, please send one JSON object with keys email, phone, residential_address, middle_name, and full_name. Do not include gender, date of birth, nationality, passport number, or passport expiration date in this message.
message_list.guideline_text: Collect Passenger Data: Ask the traveler to provide a single JSON object with keys email, phone, residential_address, middle_name, and full_name, and explicitly state that gender, date of birth, nationality, passport number, and passport expiration date must not be included in this message.

message_list.content: My email is hassan.kim@proton.me, phone number is +4587594131, and address is 6090 Prospect St, Tampa, FL, 44555. I don't have a middle name, and my full name is Hassan Kim.

Great choice. To place a free 24 hour courtesy hold, type HOLD FOR 24 HOURS.
Please confirm your contact email and mobile number. I have email hassan.kim@proton.me and mobile +4587594131.

message_list.content: Yes, those contact details are correct.

Thanks. To finalize your booking, please provide:

- Card number
- Expiration date
- Cardholder name
- Security code
- Billing ZIP code
